description: This file contains tests for escaping and unescaping property names in CEL, including handling of reserved keywords and special characters, as well as fuzz testing for robustness.

methods.name: TestEscaping
methods.description: Tests that property names are correctly escaped and unescaped, including reserved keywords and special characters.

methods.name: TestUnescapeMalformed
methods.description: Tests behavior of unescape function with malformed input strings.

methods.name: TestEscapingFuzz
methods.description: Performs fuzz testing to ensure robustness of escaping and unescaping functions.

methods.name: TestCanSkipRegex
methods.description: Tests the regex check that determines if escaping can be skipped for certain property names.

methods.name: TestCELReservedSymbolsNoDoubleUnderscore
methods.description: Ensures that CEL reserved symbols do not contain double underscores, which are used in escaping.
